subject: general
question: Among the following, which festival is celebrated by the Jain community?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Paryushana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paryushana Parva** is one of the main celebrations for Jains.
 
• Paryushan is the celebration of pardoning and sympathy.
 
• This year this Paryushan celebration will be commended from **August 24, 2022, to September 1, 2022.**
 
• **Das Lakshana or Paryushana **is the main yearly blessed occasion for Jains and is generally celebrated in August or September in Hindi schedule (Indian schedule) Bhadrapad Month's Shukla Paksha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lohri** is the festival of the appearance of longer days after the colder time of year solstice.
 
• **The Hemis **Celebration denotes the birth commemoration of Master Padmasambhava and the triumph of good over evil.
 
• **Nuakhai or Navakhai** is a horticultural celebration chiefly seen by individuals of Western Odisha and Southern Chhattisgarh in India.
 
• **Vardhamana Mahavira,** the last Tirthankara was the organizer behind Jainism.
